text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.
SOYBEAN SALE - USDA Monday said private exporters reported sales of 120,000 tonnes of soybeans to South Korea for delivery during the 1997/98 marketing year.

WHEAT SALE - An Egyptian flour miller over the weekend bought 55,000 tonnes U.S. hard red winter wheat for September 20-30 shipment, several U.S. exporters said. It was a private sale, they said. The wheat was bought $150.25 a tonne, C & F, U.S. Gulf of Mexico.

CORN SALE - South Korea has bought 50,000 tonnes of corn and is considering more donations to hungry North Korea. The state-run Agricultural and Fishery Marketing Corp said it bought the corn from China at $151.80 per tonne at a weekend tender for delivery by the end of next month.

WHEAT TENDER - Jordan is scheduled to tender July 23 for 100,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter or hard red spring wheat or equivalent wheat from other countries, U.S. exporters said. Half of the tonnage was slated for last-half August shipment and the balance for last-half September shipment.

VEGETABLE OIL TENDER - Egypt's state Holding Company for Food Industries on July 16 will seek 25,000 to 40,000 tonnes of cotton seed, sunflower seed and soybean oils for delivery in August. The tender includes 10,000 to 15,000 tonnes of crude sunflower seed oil and/or semi-refined cotton seed oil and/or American cottonseed oil PBSY 162 for arrival in the first half of August, 1997. - The same amounts and types of oil for second-half August arrival. Also, 5,000 to 10,000 tonnes of degummed soybean oil second-half August arrival.

SOYBEAN TENDER - South Korea's state-run Agricultural and Fishery Marketing Corp on July 15 will seek 40,000 tonnes of No.1 soybeans. It seeks 20,000 tonnes for September 20 arrival at Inchon and 20,000 tonnes for arrival by October 20.

CORN/SOYBEAN TENDER - The Egyptian state's Food Industries Company said it wanted to buy 30,000 tonnes of U.S. or Argentine No. 2 yellow corn for arrival in the second half of September and/or the second half of October and 30,000 tonnes of soybean, any origin, for arrival first half of October and/or first half of November. The deadline for the corn and soybean bids is noon (0900 GMT) July 22, he told Reuters.

RICE TENDERS - Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foodstuffs will receive offers until July 23 to buy 24,000 tonnes of white rice for August delivery, a GEZA spokesman said. Results would be available on July 24.
- The CCC said it was seeking on July 22 a total of 1,780 tonnes U.S. long grain rice for donation to Burkina Faso. The shipment period was due for August 21 to September 5.
MARKET TALK - Argentine soybean crushers are heading for a buildup of unusually large meal stocks, due to slower than expected demand from Far Eastern buyers, local traders said.
... The Brazilian arm of U.S. grains giant Cargill Inc and Brazilian processor Ceval Alimentos dismissed talk that Cargill had bought part or all of Ceval as unsubstantiated rumors.

... Mexico bought 100,000 tonnes of Brazilian soybeans through Veracruz port, the United Soybean Board said in a recent report. It cited unconfirmed reports that four vessels of beans were bought at $20 less than the prices of U.S. soybeans at the time.

... The United States will donate 85,000 tonnes of corn and 10,000 tonnes of rice to North Korea under two new food aid initiatives, a spokeswoman for the U.S. agency for International Development said Monday.
